name: Morning brief
description: Every morning, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super writes a short brief from what it may read about you (your work and home notes): three things to focus on, one to drop, and any deadline. You say yes before it's emailed to you. Needs NEBIUS_API_KEY, and RESEND_API_KEY to email it.

assistants.name: Briefer
assistants.description: Writes a short morning brief from what it may read about you.

steps.ask: {{input}}: write my morning brief from what you know about me. Three things to focus on, one thing to drop, and anything with a deadline, in under 120 words. Then a line of JSON: {"focus": ["...", "...", "..."]}.

steps.message:
